findings.issue: Language and technical depth under soil preparation do not match the stated beginner audience.
findings.evidence: Ensure substrate aeration via perlite amendment to optimise rhizosphere oxygenation, and calibrate the substrate's cation exchange capacity relative to your cultivar's edaphic requirements.
findings.why_it_matters: Stated audience of first-time plant owners cannot understand academic botany terms.
findings.suggested_fix: Simplify content depth to suit someone who has never kept a plant alive.

findings.issue: Directing users to cancel their plan conflicts directly with the site goal of converting readers to a care plan.
findings.evidence: Open your account page, choose Plans, then choose Cancel plan.
findings.why_it_matters: Promoting account cancellation discourages subscription conversion and conflicts with site goals.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove cancellation steps and replace with a call to action introducing Leafline's monthly care subscription.

findings.issue: Uses dense scientific jargon that fails the plain language requirement for beginners.
findings.evidence: Ensure substrate aeration via perlite amendment to optimise rhizosphere oxygenation, and calibrate the substrate's cation exchange capacity relative to your cultivar's edaphic requirements.
findings.why_it_matters: Unexplained technical terms discourage complete beginners from reading further.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite the section in plain language explaining basic soil needs simply.
findings.rewrite: Mix perlite into potting soil to help roots breathe and absorb moisture easily.
